simple.meaning: שָׂמַח (sâmach) appears 158 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 11 more, beginning at Exodus 4:14. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׂמַח through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
definitions.usage: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, × very.
